page: Amazon Web Services r7iz.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 32 vCPUs and 16 physical cores based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 6455B processor, running at a high clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per physical core. It does not include local storage or GPUs, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

In benchmark testing, the r7iz.8xlarge demonstrates strong compute and memory capabilities. It achieves top-tier performance in Geekbench single-core testing, image processing, and text processing, placing in the top 10% of tested servers. Large-block uncached memory read and write speeds are strong, measuring 224.53 GB/sec and 104.52 GB/sec respectively. The processor's advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions), contribute to strong performance in LLM inference, delivering 381.58 tokens/sec for text generation on small models and strong prompt processing speeds on medium models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the r7iz.8xlarge offers a high-density memory configuration paired with high-frequency processing, making it a viable option for workloads requiring both rapid CPU execution and substantial memory capacity. However, the lack of local NVMe storage means all storage operations must rely on network-attached volumes, which may introduce latency tradeoffs. This instance is highly suited for memory-intensive applications, relational databases, real-time data analytics, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
